title: Console Cost Insights + Rollouts: GA launch & enablement playbook
creator: Aarti Mehta
description: Objective: Coordinate a cross-functional launch for the Console Cost Insights dashboard and Rollout Controls features. This ticket centralizes launch tasks: release notes, docs, internal enablement, support runbooks, buyer-facing messaging, and the phased production rollout plan. Goal: GA launch with <1% regression in latency and clear cost transparency for token/route-level breakdowns. Success metrics include adoption (10% of org accounts opt-in within 30 days), support ticket volume < 5 related issues in week 1, and completion of training for Sales/SE/Support teams.

rollout_strategy: Phase 0 (Internal): Feature behind internal-only flag for 5 working days for smoke tests and initial telemetry
Phase 1 (Canary): 2% of production traffic for 48 hours with realtime alerting on latency/error thresholds
Phase 2 (Gradual Ramp): Increase to 25% over 3 days if metrics stable; enable in selected regions (us-west, eu-central)
Phase 3 (Universal GA): Open to all accounts with optional opt-in onboarding tour; monitor adoption and support volume for 7 days
Fallback: Automatic fallback to aggregated cost view + notify admin if tokenization errors or >2% latency regression
release_notes_draft: Introducing Cost Insights and Rollout Controls. Cost Insights surfaces per-route and per-token breakdowns in the Console so teams can identify high-cost patterns and make informed configuration changes. Rollout Controls provide canary, gradual ramp, and automatic fallback policies to manage risk during deployments. For customers: opt-in available at GA, with guided onboarding and example queries in the help center. See full docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/console/cost-insights

Feature adds telemetry overhead; risk of slight latency increase (mitigation: SRE to set tight guardrails and fallback thresholds)
